Dual Language Immersion at Washington K-8 Teaches Bilingual Skills at Elementary Level

Birmingham City Schools

December 10, 2025

Booker T. Washington held an open house today to introduce parents and stakeholders to the school's Dual Language Immersion program -- the first of its kind for not only Birmingham City Schools but also the state of Alabama.
